//AllowedHosts: PROD MUST pin this to the App Service host (e.g. pemp-web-xxxx.azurewebsites.net) — '*' is for local dev only. Override via the AllowedHosts app setting at deploy time.
//KeyVault: Set KeyVault:Uri (Bicep injects it as KeyVault__Uri on the Web App) to activate the Azure Key Vault config provider. Blank locally = no vault, dev fallbacks apply.
//Ui: ShowTraceability surfaces the FR-/SEC-/NFR- requirement-ID chips in the UI (SRS-coverage view). Off by default for the product-polished look; set true to demo traceability.
//AzureAd: Leave ClientId blank for local dev (local ASP.NET Core Identity + authenticator TOTP). Set all three (+ UseSqlite:false + a SqlServer ConnectionStrings:Pemp) to enable Entra SSO — see docs/azure-entra-setup.md.
